The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Tenders are invited from contractors/firms registered with the Public WorksDepartment/IrrigationDepartment/Rural Eng ineering Department. Enclosing a registration certificate with the tender is mandatory. 2. The tenderer/firm must be registered with the Income Tax and GST departments. The applicable income tax and GST wi ll be deducted from the bill as per rules. 3. The tendered/firm must attach a photocopy of their PAN c ard, GST certificate, and Aadhaar card. 4. Any tenderer/firm registered with the State Treasury Coun cil will be prohibited from submitting the tender.

5. A self-declaration affidavit must be submitted on a notariz ed affidavit for a fee of Rs. 10/- only. The tender must have no criminal record against him/her. Those with a criminal rec ord are not eligible to participate in the tender process. 6- Character certificates and status certificates must be atta ched, issued under the signature of the District Magistrate/C ollector of the district. Certificates issued by any other officia l will not be accepted. 7. As per rules, a bank draft/FDR/account payee cheque of 2 % earnest money, payable to the Principal, must be attache d with the tender form. Otherwise, the tender will be rejecte d. 8. Upon acceptance of the tender, the concerned contractor/ firmer must deposit a bank draft/FDR/account payee cheque of 5% earnest money with the college within one week of rec eiving the work order, otherwise, the work order will be auto matically cancelled. 9. Bidders/firmers can view the estimates and rates prepare d by the PWD for the college campus work on any working d ay. 10. The tenderer /firmer will be awarded the construction wo rk within the budget received for Rs. It will be mandatory to complete the work within 30 days from the date of contract. 11. The Principal will have full authority to cancel the tender without assigning any reason. 12. The financial bid will be opened only if the technical bid o f the tenderer is found to be technically correct. 13. On completion of the work as per the terms of the tender , the bill will have to be certified and submitted in duplicate t o the undersigned's office so that the payment related proce ss can be completed on time. . 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) महावालय परसर म थत शासिनक भवन के पीछे 10*8 के एक कमरे का िनमाण , वतु फटग, पानी क फटग सहत काय कया जायेगा, (जसक छत आर सी सी से िनिमत हो) साथ ह उसह म एक छोटे क का िनमाण भी कराया जायेगा। 11. Purchase Preference (Centre) Bid reserved for Make In India products: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Class 1 local suppliers as defined in public procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 as amended from time to time and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Nodal Ministry for specific Goods/Products. The minimum local content to qualify as a class 1 local supplier is denoted in the bid document 50%. All bidders must upload a certificate from the OEM regarding the percentage of the local content and the details of locations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. In case the bid value is more than Rs 10 Crore, the declaration relating to percentage of local content shall be certified by the statutory auditor or cost auditor, if the OEM is a company and by a practicing cost accountant or a chartered accountant for OEMs other than companies as per the Public Procurement (preference to Make-in -India) order 2017 dated 04.06.2020 . In case Buyer has selected Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises clause in the bid, the same will get precedence over this clause. 12. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PRINCIPAL GOVERNMENT RAZA PG COLLEGE payable at RAMPUR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
